reply: The 7-point score is 6, which is decidable and meets or exceeds the threshold of 3. The criteria_implied_action is excision due to the score being 6 >= 3. According to guideline recommendation DOI:10.1016/j.jaad.2018.08.055, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended as first-line treatment for primary melanoma; additionally, per DOI:10.1016/j.ejca.2024.115153, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.
